parsed.summary: Every component, value and interface the specification states explicitly matches the drawing: U8/U9 are MCP2515-xSO with Y1/Y2 both reading 16 MHz (the board_TODO correction is honoured), U6 is the LTC4412xS6 ideal-diode controller with its P-ch MOSFET Q1, U5/U24 are ISL54222AIUZ switches, U15/U22/U35/U36 and U18/U19 are SN74LVC1G07 buffers wired as the spec describes, D9/D10 are the SM712-type CAN TVS arrays, and GLOBAL_EN is tied directly to SW1 pin 2 with no sequencing part. The USB power path, GLOBAL_EN boot behaviour, CAN LED polarity and the PoE isolation are all documented open/known issues in the spec, not deviations, and the apparent reference collisions I could see are artifacts of mis-reading small rotated text rather than real netlist merges. I therefore find no drawing-supported anomaly.
